# Printing HERALDRY SKIRMISH RC490 at home (borderless US Letter)

Files
* `Heraldry_RC490_inkjet-borderless.pdf` — interior, warm cream page tone to every edge.
* `Heraldry_RC490_inkjet-borderless-white.pdf` — identical interior on paper white (use on cream stock or to save ink). Same pages, same page numbers.
* `Heraldry_RC490_covers-front-back.pdf` (and `-white`) — front cover (page 1) and back cover (page 2), Letter portrait.
* `Heraldry_RC490_inkjet-calibration.pdf` — one diagnostic sheet. Print it first.

Settings (application print dialog)
1. Paper size **Letter**, orientation **portrait**, **one PDF page per sheet**.
2. **Borderless: on** (the option may be under Paper/Quality, Layout or Advanced, depending on the driver).
3. Scale **Actual size / 100%** in the application. Do not use Fit, Shrink oversized pages or any extra scaling. Some drivers still enlarge borderless output slightly even at 100%; that expansion is the driver's, not an error in the file.
4. If the driver offers an amount of borderless expansion, start at the lowest setting that leaves no white edge, then adjust from the calibration print.
5. Choose the media type and quality matching your paper. No single setting suits every printer; follow your printer's manual for borderless-capable media and paper sources.

Calibration check (before printing the book)
* The 1-inch square measures 1 inch.
* The solid **3/8 SAFE** frame is fully visible on all four sides. The book keeps all text, folios and diagram labels at least 3/8 inch from every edge; if your printer crops into this frame, reduce borderless expansion.
* 9 pt text and the 0.3 pt rule are legible; table bands are visible but light; hatch lines stay separate; the cream tone reaches every edge.

Double-sided printing
The interior has facing-page margins (wider inside margin on the binding side; odd pages are right-hand pages). Test duplex on 4 pages first: confirm flip on the **long edge** and that page 2 backs page 1 the right way up. If automatic duplex is not available for borderless printing on your printer, print odd pages, reinsert the stack as the manual-duplex instructions of your printer describe, then print even pages.

Status
The files pass automated file checks (page size/boxes, edge safety, type size, embedded fonts, edge-to-edge substrate). **Physical printing has NOT been tested** on any printer: verify colour of the cream tone, edge coverage and duplex alignment with your own device and paper.
